data.name: TimeRestriction_Blocked
data.value: Sales of this item are not permitted after {0}.

data.name: TimeRestriction_BlockedAtCheckout
data.value: Cart contains items that cannot be sold after {0}. Remove restricted items to proceed.

data.name: TimeRestriction_PermittedTimeWindowFormat
data.value: Sales of {0} are only permitted between {1} and {2}.
data.comment: Format: item name, start time, end time. Example: Sales of this item are only permitted between 08:00 and 20:00.

data.name: TimeRestriction_NotPermittedAfterFormat
data.value: Sales of {0} are not permitted after {1}.
data.comment: Format: item name, cutoff time. Example: Sales of this item are not permitted after 20:00.

data.name: TimeRestriction_NotPermittedBeforeFormat
data.value: Sales of {0} are not permitted before {1}.
data.comment: Format: item name, start time. Example: Sales of this item are not permitted before 08:00.

data.name: TimeRestriction_NotPermittedGeneric
data.value: Sales of {0} are restricted at this time.
data.comment: Format: item name. Example: Sales of this item are restricted at this time.

data.name: TimeRestriction_DefaultItemName
data.comment: Default item name when cart line description is not available
